models.title: 7-1-20 Coal stockpile month end
models.author: Monte_McCoy
models.use: Textured photogrammetry coal yard, fitted along the western service road
models.review: Accepted 2026-10-12: raw GLB visually reviewed in Chromium; photographed coal mounds, excavation marks and stockyard ground retained. Uniformly fitted and rotated for the illustrative campus. Weld + simplify ratio 0.2 / error 0.002 before 1K WebP + meshopt compression; optimized 120,911-triangle / 1,124,524-byte scene visually reviewed again standalone and in the plant.

models.title: Wind Turbine
models.author: Shivansh Singh
models.use: Repeated wind turbines in land and offshore clusters; separate blade pivot follows per-unit simulated RPM
models.review: Accepted 2026-10-12 after standalone and plant Chromium review: clean tapered tower, nacelle and three red-tipped blades; separate rotor pivot retained with flatten/join disabled. Scaled for illustrative 5 MW land / 12 MW offshore units; offshore foundation added in code. Optimized1367 triangles,26628 bytes, WebP/meshopt. Animates from server RPM; storm cut-out stops rotation.

models.title: Solar Panel
models.author: marioeatsdirt
models.use: GPU-instanced representative fixed-tilt PV arrays across twelve blocks
models.review: Accepted 2026-10-12 after standalone and plant Chromium review: framed module with visible cell grid. Texture compressed to WebP; geometry retains full floating-point precision to avoid coplanar artifacts (312 triangles,48692 bytes). Repeated560 times per representative block with tilt, scale and blue material tint; capacities are illustrative, not a module-count survey.
